svg.title: Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert dynamics on the unit sphere: precession, overdamped geodesic, and renormalization
svg.desc: Numerically integrated 3D orthographic projection of the unit sphere S^2 showing helical damped precession (s_prec = 1), geodesic overdamped relaxation (s_prec = 0), the orthogonal precession and damping torque vectors in T_m S^2, monotonic energy decay dE/dt <= 0, and radial projection of explicit RK stage drift back onto S^2.
svg.text: Landau–Lifshitz–Gilbert Dynamics on the Unit Sphere S2 (‖m‖2 = 1)
Numerically integrated precession (sprec = 1) vs. geodesic damping (sprec = 0), monotonic dissipation, and RK sphere projection
Explicit LLG: ∂tm = −γ0/(1+α2) [ sprec m×Heff + α m×(m×Heff) ]
Computed from RK4 solutions of (a) for τdirect = 0, stationary Heff
Discrete RK Drift & Radial Projection onto S2
